programme.title: The Body Beneath
programme.desc: 1970. Horror. Director: Andy Milligan. Stars Gavin Reed, Jackie Skarvellis & Berwick Kaler. A family of vampires are searching for new blood since a inbreeding is destroying the family line...

programme.title: Showdown At Spiggots Store
programme.desc: 1984. Stars. An entertaining short film about two women who are hitch-hiking with little to no luck until a kind truck driver helps them. The ride does not turn out to be as simple as it seemed.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1994. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Kylie Minogue is interviewed by Jean Paul. We are joined by some of Kylie Minogue's biggests fans in Dublin, three drag queens.

programme.title: The Perfect Woman (1981)
programme.desc: 1978. Two dumb aliens are sent to earth to find an earthwoman suitable to be the wife of their leader. Stars Cameron Mitchell.

programme.title: Up The Chastity Belt
programme.desc: 1971. Comedy. Director: Bob Kellett. Stars: Frankie Howerd, Eartha Kitt, Anna Quayle, Roy Hudd. Lurkalot is a serf who sells chastity belts and love potions at the local market place.

programme.title: Look At Life Stuck on Stamps
programme.desc: 1968. An incredible look at stamps in Britain from their design to their issue.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Roman Wall. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. King Boltoan tells Lancelot and Brian that his daughter has been abducted by ghostly warriors dressed as Romans.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: Raptures of the Deep. 1964. Stars Ray Barrett, Robert Easton & Gary Miller. While the Stingray crew go to the rescue of two crazy treasure hunters, Troy falls down a crevasse and runs out of air.

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. The Swinging Mrs Jones. Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. Honey poses as a society matron in an effort to smash a blackmailing ring.

programme.title: Dick Tracy's G-Men
programme.desc: 1939. Action. Directors: John English & William Witney. Stars Ralph Byrd, Irving Pichel & Ted Pearson. A mad doctor uses a drug to bring himself back from the dead after his execution in prison.

programme.title: Spaceways
programme.desc: 1953. Sci-fi. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Howard Duff, Eva Bartok & Alan Wheatley. When a test launch of a satellite fails, two people attached to the secret project mysteriously go missing.

programme.title: Tarzan and the Green Goddess
programme.desc: 1937. Adventure. Director: Edward A. Kull & Wilbur McGaugh. Stars Bruce Bennett, Ula Holt & Frank Baker. Tarzan, Martling and Ula retrieve a Mayan idol, leading them into chaos in the jungle!

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Lafe Lingers On. 1964. Stars Donna Douglas, Peter Whitney & Max Baer Jr. Lafe Crick returns to the Clampett mansion with another scheme to try to get rich off of Jed's money.

programme.title: Jack the Giant Killer
programme.desc: 1962. Fantasy. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars Kerwin Mathews, Judi Meredith, & Torin Thatcher. The treacherous Pendragon plots to gain the throne of Cornwall. Can anyone stop the evil sorcerer?

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: King Tut's Coup. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. An Egyptology professor believes he is King Tut and kidnaps Lisa. Batman and Robin track him down but end up in troubled waters!

programme.title: The Calendar
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Arthur Crabtree. Stars Greta Gynt, John McCallum & Raymond Lovell. A racehorse owner becomes involved in a scandal after losing his money and his fiancée.

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are Lynda Bellingham, Robin Cousins, Tim Flavin, Bonnie Langford, Paul Nicholas and Marti Webb.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Finny Foot Affair. 1964. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum, Kurt Russell & Leo G. Carroll. Solo is trying to track down a chemical agent that hastens the aging process.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Happy St David's Day! Enjoy the brilliant Llantrisant Choir, then Mike & Noel have a great short film full of footballers in 1945 as well as a wonderful Scopitone of Gary Lewis & The Playboys!

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: Death with Due Notice. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. A quiet break in the country turns into a weekend of murder when Hannay is targeted by a killer.
